design_rules: Every placed part has an LCSC field naming an in-stock JLCPCB part; verify the exported BOM with scripts/jlc-stock.ts before ordering.
The I2C bus has exactly one pull-up pair: 4.7k to +3V3 on the esp32-core sheet. Module sheets add no pull-ups.
Vehicle-side nets (VIN_RAW, ALT_RAW, PULSE_RAW, VEH_GND, RS485_A, RS485_B) use the Vehicle netclass: 0.8 mm clearance and no copper pour in the vehicle area on either layer.
Keep the LIS3MDL magnetometer at least 20 mm from the PSU header area, the CR2032 holder, the screw terminals and any inductor; place MPU-6500 and LIS3MDL with the same orientation.
Route USB D+/D- as a 90-ohm differential pair over unbroken GND.
Put the antenna end of the ESP32 module at the board edge with a copper keep-out on both layers under and around the antenna.
